decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (Design and Access Statement, 5124/10A, 102A, 103A, 104, 105, 207A, 208, 209 and 210 received 13/12/2010 and Travel Plan received 30/03/2011. (Submitted for 00586/B/S15) and 5124/230 received 06.07.12.) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The access doorway to the school shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
Condition : 5 - The Travel Plan received 30/03/2011 shall be fully complied with in all regards unless otherwise agreed in writing beforehand by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Removal of Condition 6 (Drop off/collection Zone) of 00586/B/S15 granted on 11/04/2011 for the erection of a single storey extension linking the junior school and infant school buildings to provide six classrooms, a staff room, a resource room, and welfare facilities, and erection of single storey extensions to the junior school building and the nursery building with roof alterations to the nursery.
